working_definition: Testis somatic cyst cells of the adult male body, as a single grouped AFCA type covering the FCA testis cyst-cell stages (cyst stem cell, early/intermediate/late cyst cells, spermatocyte cyst cells, head cyst cell). Cyst cells enclose germline cysts during spermatogenesis. Authors' broad class: male reproductive system.

best_match.fbbt_definition: One of a pair of somatic cells that envelope each cyst of developing male germline cells.

justification: The authors' label 'cyst cell' is a grouped call over the testis somatic cyst-cell stages. 'cyst cell of testis' is the common parent of the stage-specific cyst-cell terms (spermatocyte cyst cell FBbt:00057004, spermatogonial cyst cell FBbt:00059172, spermatid cyst cell FBbt:00057008, head cyst cell FBbt:00057009) and matches the level the authors named, consistent with the curator-reviewed FCA mappings. The cyst stem cell member maps to 'cyst progenitor cell' (FBbt:00004933), which is not a child of 'cyst cell of testis' (its parents are gonadal somatic stem cell and somatic cell of testis). The cell-level term that strictly covers every member would be 'somatic cell of testis', but that is broader than the type the authors named.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A(n) somatic cell that is part of a(n) testis.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Broader than the type the authors named ('cyst cell'); cyst stem cells are a minor member of the group.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A somatic stem cell; Mother of cyst cells; Associated with the hub of the germinal center and with male germline stem cells.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers only the cyst stem cell member, not the cyst-cell stages.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A cyst cell which is part of a spermatocyte cyst.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Single stage; the AFCA label groups all cyst-cell stages.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: The member of a cyst cell pair that envelopes the head of a developing spermatid.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Single subtype; the AFCA label groups all cyst-cell stages.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00004931 'cyst cell of testis' as a broad match for the grouped AFCA cyst cell type. The cyst stem cell member (FBbt:00004933) falls outside this term but is a minor part of the group; the relation is composed primarily of.
